entry.title: Updated: dsh-task-control
entry.summary: Pause / resume / cancel the in-flight conversation task from the composer area: forced pause interrupts immediately and remembers the interrupted tool, safe pause lands after the tool or reasoning finishes, resume asks for confirmation, and the default pause granularity is configurable in the settings. Exact install spec: github:p2coder/dsh-task-control. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
